name: Diana Lam
office: City of Rosemead, Member of the City Council

items.text: Diana Lam is a career education manager running for Rosemead City Council. She worked at Bank of America Securities and was a Schwarzman Scholar. Her campaign says she has led community engagement efforts with CAUSE and LA Forward and worked in local, state, and congressional offices.

sentences.text: Diana Lam is a career education manager running for Rosemead City Council.
She worked at Bank of America Securities and was a Schwarzman Scholar.
Her campaign says she has led community engagement efforts with CAUSE and LA Forward and worked in local, state, and congressional offices.

items.text: She wants to simplify City Hall services by reducing extra steps and replacing outdated systems, according to her campaign site. She supports providing city programs and information in the languages residents speak. She proposes investing in Garvey Avenue and Valley Boulevard, working with neighboring cities. She also calls for archiving the city’s history, creating a public historical walk, and restoring community gardens and landmarks.
